cutoff_rule: For target date D, use market data through the prior trading day and news seen by 23:59:59 JST on calendar day D-1.

anti_leakage.price: No target-day or later prices are used in features.
anti_leakage.news: GDELT articles are filtered by seen_jst <= the displayed information cutoff.
anti_leakage.actual: Target-day close is used only after the prediction is frozen, for scoring.

news_model: Headline keyword sentiment, experimental. World-news headlines are archived for audit but not yet added to the score.
